title: Surreal Serpent Garden
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a large orange-red snake with detailed scales emerging from the left, its tongue extended toward a smaller magenta snake on the right. Both snakes are surrounded by floating bananas on rocky cliffs, a giant red chrysanthemum-like flower with multiple faces in the center, and two stylized female faces with ornate patterns in the background.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic landscape featuring a large detailed orange-red snake with open mouth and extended tongue on the left, facing a smaller bright magenta snake on the right. Floating yellow bananas on mossy rock cliffs on both sides. Large red chrysanthemum flower with embedded human faces in the center foreground. Two ornate stylized female faces with curly hair and decorative patterns floating in the background. Floating green and orange geometric shapes, swirling orange sky forms, dramatic sunset lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
